source:
@@U01698@@
so everyone could see her,
the music, the dances,
always had to be first,
and him,
always wheedling her with pastries and wine.
And the way she put on,
you'd think she was some real beauty.
The brass of the girl,
hadn't the decency to be ashamed!
The presents he was always throwing at her!
Disgusting, the way they petted and
slobbered over each other!
So that’s another cherry off the tree.

@@U01700@@
Poor thing!

@@U01702@@
You're sorry for her?
God!
Nights when girls like us were indoor spinning,
our mothers never taking their eyes off us,
there she was on the bench by the door,
or in some dark passageway,
with you-know-who.
Time didn’t seem to matter for her then.
So now she'll just have to pay up—
Sunday in church in her sinner’s shift!

@@U01704@@
But surely he’ll marry her.

@@U01706@@
And be a fool?
Smart lad like him?
With all those other fish in the sea?
Not likely! Besides,
he’s long gone.
translation:
@@U01698@@
让大家都能看到她，
音乐、舞蹈、
永远必须是第一，
还有他，
总是用糕点和酒来引诱她。
还有她的穿着方式，
你会认为她是一位真正的美女。
女孩的黄铜，
没有羞耻的体面！
他总是扔给她的礼物！
恶心，他们抚摸的方式
互相流口水！
所以这是又一颗樱桃。

@@U01700@@
可怜的东西！

@@U01702@@
你对不起她吗？
上帝！
当像我们这样的女孩在室内旋转的夜晚，
我们的母亲从来没有把目光从我们身上移开，
她坐在门边的长凳上，
或者在某个黑暗的通道里，
与你认识的人。
那时，时间对她来说似乎并不重要。
所以现在她只需要付出代价——
周日在教堂里轮班！

@@U01704@@
但他肯定会娶她。

@@U01706@@
并成为一个傻瓜？
像他这样聪明的小伙子？
和海里其他的鱼一起吗？
不太可能！此外，
他已经走了很久了。
